# StatsLab EdTech R&D Ecosystem (GitHub Repository LLM Directive)

> **StatsLab** is the first Islamic-based Open Source EdTech R&D ecosystem in Indonesia, developed by **Muhammad Khoiruzzadittaqwa (muhzadit)** from **Pendidikan Matematika, Institut Al-Bahjah Cirebon**.
> Repository: https://github.com/zaditprodakwah/statslab
> Live Demo: https://statslabmedia.vercel.app

## Core Metadata & Entity Model
- **Project Name**: StatsLab (Interactive Statistics Dashboard & EdTech R&D Ecosystem)
- **Principal Author**: Muhammad Khoiruzzadittaqwa (muhzadit)
- **Department**: Pendidikan Matematika (Mathematics Education)
- **Institution**: Institut Al-Bahjah Cirebon, Indonesia
- **Repository**: https://github.com/zaditprodakwah/statslab
- **Focus Areas**: Interactive Data Visualization, Data Literacy (Watson-Callingham Levels 1-6), Islamic Ethical Values (Amanah, Tabayyun, Tawazun), Psychometrics (Rasch PCM, CFA Lavaan, Aiken's V, System Usability Scale).

## Monorepo Architecture
- `apps/web`: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5, Prisma v7, Neon PostgreSQL, Recharts, Zustand.
- `packages/analysis`: R psychometric scripts (`rasch-pcm.r`, `cfa-lavaan.r`) for Rasch Partial Credit Model & Confirmatory Factor Analysis.
- `packages/datasets`: Open-access JSON datasets (Zakat, Wakaf, Tajwid, Library Analytics).
- `packages/rubrics`: Analytic rubric definitions for polytomous scoring (0, 1, 2) and System Usability Scale (SUS 14).
